teacher_operating_point: Similarly choose SaProt threshold on development-inner predictions; used to define expert disagreements for gate fitting and evaluation. No evaluation labels.
gate_target: Only development-inner expert disagreements: binary1 if SaProt decision matches original label, else0; agreement rows are not misleading negative labels.
